text:
alex: quick follow-up on RFC — activation windows for on-prem bundles when operators might be older. worried about accidental immediate activation during staged rollouts.

meera: +1 for delayed activation. we saw kube-operator hooks break activations last time. :grimacing:

sam: thinking pattern: signed bundle + apply-only phase, then explicit activation ticket. bundle lands on disk but is inert until operator receives a ticket (with TTL). simplifies staging.

ira: ticket TTL implies clocks. air-gapped clusters often have drift; we can't rely on strict time windows everywhere.

jules: alternative is operator-side lease/handshake: bundle carries activation-seq and operator only flips active after cluster leader sees >N node ACKs. no global clock required.

alex: tradeoffs: ticket+TTL = central control from console, easier for audits. lease/handshake = more operator complexity and requires leader election semantics to be stable across versions.

sam: fallback required: if activation not acknowledged within X days, auto-clean or mark for manual review. can't leave half-applied state forever.

meera: signing formats — we need KMS/HSM-backed sigs for enterprise + PGP/armored for fully disconnected customers. manifest should enumerate sig type so operator knows how to verify.

alex: sample manifest snippet: 
```yaml
version: 1
bundle: redwood-onprem-1.4.0.tar.gz
sha256: abc123...
signature:
  type: kms
  key_id: projects/acme/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/rw-sign
activation:
  mode: ticket
  ttl_sec: 86400
```

ira: for PGP/offline: signature.type=pgp and include armored sig blob next to the manifest file. operator verifies with provided public key bundle.

sam: operator compatibility matrix note: operator v>=1.3 understands activation-seq/lease; v<1.3 will fall back to legacy apply+activate which is risky. we should consider a shim or rejection path.

jules: rejecting is safer than silently activating. maybe operator should return 'upgrade-blocked: need newer operator' and surface to support.

alex: rollout flow proposal: 1) push bundle to nodes in apply-only mode 2) generate per-batch activation tokens 3) operator validates signature + compatibility and activates when token presented.

deploy-bot: deploy: bundle uploaded to 12 clusters, staged activation scheduled for 2026-07-15T00:00Z (manual override allowed)

meera: edge case: nodes that never reconnect before activation window must not be remotely activated. activation must be initiated locally by the operator when token seen. we can't reach across air-gap.

sam: rollback plan: keep prior bundle as inactive but available; operator performs atomic swap (symlink) to rollback quickly. need integration tests for config migrations.

alex: action items:
- sam: write operator handshake proto + backward-compat RFC draft (due: 2w)
- meera: spec offline signature formats + KMS mapping (due: 1w)
- ira: add clock-drift mitigation options and diagnostics (due: 1w)
- jules: propose user-visible CLI flow for batch tokens and audit fields (due: 1w)

jules: also add audit entry format: who generated token, token -> bundle mapping, operator acknowledgements.

alex: note: defaults ok, but don't hard-code TTLs. make them configurable per-customer.

meera: i'll start a docs stub for the activation modes and examples.

sam: i'll open the proto sketch PR and include test vectors for sig verification.

alex: thanks — we'll review in arch sync next Wed. :thumbsup:
